messages:
DeployBot: deploy attempt: release v2.14.0-rc -> staging. SBOM scan: UNKNOWN_SIGNATURE on image registry.redwood.com/core:2.14.0-rc; action: HOLD. logs: /artifacts/3775001234/sbom-report.json
Maya Rivera: pinging release here — what's the minimal ask to move forward?
Tom H: quick glance: flag is on transitive dep 'cruftlib' (sha256:abc123) used only by analytics worker. not in inference path.
Priya S: thanks. is it unsigned or mismatched cosign? DeployBot said UNKNOWN_SIGNATURE so likely cosign missing.
LegalBot: we need provenance evidence before EU rollout. can we get the raw build metadata + builder ID? link to cosign attestation would suffice.
Maya Rivera: if it's non-prod-only (analytics), can we carve out EU canary and continue global staging?
Tom H: technically yes — we can do a region-scoped rollout: set release.targets = [us-west-1, us-east-1] and skip eu until cleared. small risk: customers hitting eu may see older behavior.
Priya S: alternatives: 1) pin artifact to previous digest (core:2.13.9) and resume 2) attach cosign signature if build system can re-run quickly 3) staggered unpublish of the single analytics worker image and replace with pinned version.
QA Bot: test matrix note: analytics worker change affects metrics pipeline; will need smoke + metrics sanity check (approx 20m) before canary.
Maya Rivera: timeline ask: can we get signature re-run in <45m? Tom?
Tom H: build infra queue is light. I can re-run cosign attestation now — ETA ~22m. I'll post artifact link when done.
DeployBot: manual override option available: /deploy override --reason "provenance pending" --targets us-west-1,us-east-1  (requires 2 approvals).
Maya Rivera: ok: Priya, Legal — can you weigh in? if Tom gets attestation in 30m we can avoid pin/unpublish.
Priya S: I prefer signed attestation. safer than pinning (we'll lose fixes). +1 to wait for Tom.
LegalBot: +1 signed attestation. if Tom provides builder ID & signature, legal will OK EU carveout.
Maya Rivera: noted — I'll update release notes to include: "staged rollout: EU deferred pending SBOM provenance" and draft a short customer-facing blurb in case of questions.
Tom H: started re-run: `bazel build //services/analytics:worker && cosign sign --key ksm://releases/tokens builder-attest.json`
Tom H: uploaded attestation -> https://artifacts.redwood.com/attest/3775001234/cosign.json
DeployBot: attestation received; SBOM re-scan PASS (signature verified). HOLD cleared for staging targets.
Maya Rivera: awesome. proceeding with staggered rollout (us-west-1, us-east-1). leaving EU off until legal confirms final notes.
LegalBot: received attestation, verification OK. will mark EU review as OK pending final audit doc (I'll post checklist in this thread).
QA Bot: canary rolling to us-west-1 now. smoke checks live.
Maya Rivera: thanks everyone — tagging release docs owner @Priya S to add the EU defer note and the provenance link to release notes. :thumbsup:
Priya S: on it, will update release notes + changelog entry.
Maya Rivera: closing thread once EU is cleared; leaving timestamps in release notes for traceability.
